title: Design Intelligence project connection record
description: Optional machine-readable form of a consumer project's docs/DESIGN_INTELLIGENCE.md. The Markdown record is the contract (see docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md §3); this schema exists for tooling and for the HeldyOS bridge. Records live in the CONSUMER repository, never here.

project_id.description: Stable slug for the project. Must match the project_id used in the HeldyOS adoption note.

repository_url.description: Canonical URL of the consumer project repository.

status.description: Integration status of this project with Design Intelligence. Distinct from a registry entry's status.

product_type.description: Surface class. Drives the one-opinion-skill selection in AGENTS.md rule 3. 'mixed' must be resolved to a single surface type per task by the Design Director.

canonical_design_intelligence_url.description: The canonical Design Intelligence repository. Recorded explicitly so a consumer never guesses.

canonical_ref.description: The pinned ref of the canonical repository this project was last reviewed against. 'main' is not a ref for review purposes (contract §8).

kind.description: commit = full 40-char SHA (preferred); tag = release tag; registry-version = registry.yaml 'version' plus 'updated'.

integration_doc.description: Repo-relative path to this project's filled-in connection record.

brand_system_path.description: Repo-relative path to the project's brand system as implemented (tokens, type roles, palette, motion language).

design_decision_log_path.description: Repo-relative path to the dated log of accepted and rejected design decisions (contract §10).

reusable_findings_path.description: Repo-relative path to the staging file for lessons proposed back to Design Intelligence (contract §9).

applicable_agents.description: Design Intelligence agent specs this project runs. Referenced by id; the specs themselves are never copied here (contract §11).

applicable_registry_entries.description: Registry entry ids that apply to this project. Each value MUST match an 'id' in registry.yaml at canonical_ref. Kept as a pattern rather than an enum so the schema does not go stale when the registry changes.

status_at_review.description: Snapshot of the entry's status at canonical_ref. Informational; registry.yaml is authoritative.

why.description: Why this entry applies to this project.

exceptions.description: Standing overrides and permanently rejected recommendations (contract §10). Accessibility failures MUST NOT be recorded here; they are open defects with remediation dates.

rule.description: The directive or recommendation being overridden.

source.description: Registry entry id or agent id the directive came from.

reason.description: Why the project overrides it. 'Brand mandates X' is a reason; 'we prefer it' is not.

expires.description: Review date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null for a permanent brand rule. An exception with no expiry becomes silent policy.

last_reviewed.description: Date a human last re-read the canonical repository for this project (YYYY-MM-DD).

owner.description: Person accountable for design decisions in this project.

obsidian_note.description: Optional pointer to the HeldyOS adoption note. There is no automatic connection to Obsidian (see docs/HELDYOS_BRIDGE.md §1).
